records.claim: Studies have not been done to see if fluticasone could affect men’s fertility (ability to make healthy sperm) or increase the chance of birth defects. In general, exposures that fathers or sperm donors have are unlikely to increase risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: If a man takes fluticasone, could it affect his fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
